segments.en: Does something happen on this app?
And tell me, what do you do?
Why do I feel like you are sitting in class and talking to me?
I am sitting on a bed.
Oh, do you have a job?
Actually, I only like businessmen. People who do jobs get a salary, but businessmen... if the business settles, then I am rich, then I will buy everything.
I am a girl, right? I have my own dreams that I want to become a very big businesswoman. Money and money.
Because right now, I feel like everything is just stopping.
I don't know, what is your side? I am telling you about my side. Whoever has this, they have people roaming around them.
Look at Narendra Modi, making tea, the poor guy reached where he is.
Now reels come up, right, that sugar has become expensive because Narendra Modi also reached that post while making tea. It's funny to see this.
So, how long have you been on this app?

Oh, one week. Actually, it happens that on this app, I mostly find people whose hearts are broken, who are alone. They come to this app by overthinking. And I myself, I am also like that. My heart is broken. What about you? Your heart must have been broken too, that's why you came.
Nothing happened, just came to have fun.
No, no. No person comes like this without a reason.

I also, you know, came here from Instagram. I thought that I would get it earlier. I was going into so much depression, this, that, overthinking. Instead of that, I would have gotten this app, I would have talked to everyone, chilled, and chilled, chill, in life, one should chill.
I have done so much blabbering. By the way, what is your business?
Oh, okay, okay, okay. That's fine, man. I am doing nursing. I directly give injections, injections.
Take an injection. I think if someone has a headache, I don't give them stomach ache injections or medicines. I have so much trust in myself, doing nursing.
